settings.hero_desc: A sleek model of a solar-powered pod home - curved shell, solar-panel roof and a furnished interior on show - mounted on a clean base. The ideal way to pitch an eco-dwelling concept to investors and buyers.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your design, interior, finishes and base
settings.s1_body: We bring eco-dwelling concepts to life as detailed scale models. This solar pod features a curved shell, a roof of solar panels and an open, furnished interior so people can see how the space lives. Built from your design, it's a compelling centrepiece for pitching sustainable housing to investors, partners and buyers.
settings.case_body: Built to present a solar pod concept, this model let the team show both the sustainable design and the liveable interior - helping investors and buyers grasp the idea far faster than renders alone.
settings.case_quote: It made our eco concept tangible. Investors could finally see exactly what we were proposing.
settings.prov_p: Sustainable design sells on feeling as much as facts. A model that shows the solar roof and the living space lets people picture themselves in a greener home.
